sentence: This project builds tools that find why machine learning models fail and repair them, using simpler models to explain complex ones.
This project studies how organisms allocate energy to growth, survival, and reproduction across their life cycles.
This project gets microscopes with networked digital cameras for use in many biology courses.
This project builds a 3D printable bioink that lets ultrasound trigger the delivery of genetic material to cells.
This project tries to find out how a fungus makes small molecules that may act as chemical weapons against a weed.
This project studies how neurons that release two neurotransmitters are controlled in fruit flies and how the social environment changes this.
This project studies how Arctic charr in lakes may cope with a warming climate by looking at their diets, feeding traits and movements.
This project tests a hands-on way of teaching AI, robotics and ethics through a five-day summer summit.
This project designs a platform that brings together career information tools, robotics activities and simple AI simulations.
This project builds software and computer designs that reduce the effect of errors when running programs on quantum computers.
This project develops a portable sensor that detects airborne chemicals linked to human health conditions and plant diseases.
This project studies how scientists think about security and privacy for their computers and data, and what tools they use.
This project brings genomic training and Next Generation Sequencing technology to high school and college classrooms.
This project works on ways to engineer complex tissues using 3D bioprinting, stem cells and gene editing.
This project builds an imaging tool that uses patterned ultraviolet light and artificial intelligence to show tissue detail without slides.
This project gets a nuclear magnetic resonance spectrometer to study how molecules bind, assemble and react.
This project studies how different feeding habits evolved in blow flies and which genes are linked to them.
This project builds a computer method that uses artificial intelligence to predict how nitinol medical devices break near tiny defects.
